Notes: Secondhand Peddler (Jean), Arete Landing market. Dialog captured 2026-11-12 by Gopherballs. "Can you tell me what you are selling?" had no follow-up captured; it uses the captured shopping-cart line so the sale window still opens.

look.Text: Can I have a look at what you are selling?

tell.Text: Can you tell me what you are selling?

hello.Text: Hello, you can call me Jean.  I am trading in secondhand goods.

cart.Text: Yes, just press the button below - the one marked with the symbol of a Shopping Cart. It will give you an overview of my current stock.{shop}
